questions.callback_requested: Did the CUSTOMER explicitly request or accept a callback? Reply exactly yes or no. Do not infer consent from an assistant suggestion alone.
questions.callback_date: What calendar date did the CUSTOMER request for a callback? Resolve relative days using the provided call_date in Asia/Kolkata (IST). Reply only YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string if unspecified or ambiguous. Do not invent a date.
questions.callback_time: What local IST time did the CUSTOMER request for a callback? Reply only HH:MM in 24-hour format, or empty string if unspecified or ambiguous. Do not invent a time.
questions.language: Which language did the CUSTOMER explicitly prefer for the callback? Reply Hindi, English, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, or Other. Reply empty string if not specified. Do not infer from their identity.
questions.budget_inr: What budget in INR did the CUSTOMER explicitly state? Reply digits only without currency punctuation; e.g. दस हज़ार is 10000. Reply empty string if unstated. This is customer budget, never a product quote.
questions.concern: Describe the obstacle the CUSTOMER expressed in one short English sentence. Do not invent a concern. Reply empty string if no concern was stated.
questions.evidence: Give the exact CUSTOMER utterances supporting callback day, time, language and budget. Quote the transcript verbatim; do not include assistant claims as customer evidence.
